producer_report.summary: I moved the status-rendering group out of display.rs into the new crates/athena-cli/src/display/status_view.rs. It holds `plan_suffix`, `lines_section`, `trend_section`, `repeated_causes_section`, `dormant_causes_section`, `snapshot_status`, `status`, `code_health_section` and `introspection`. display.rs re-exports `status` and `snapshot_status`, so no caller changes. The bodies are verbatim and the helpers they share stay in display.rs. By my count display.rs drops from 1504 to about 1030 production lines; I did not run the code-health measurement. Clippy on all athena-cli targets is clean, the 22 display tests pass, and the policy scan passes. I added a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (test module excluded), and the moved functions live in a new submodule file under crates/athena-cli/src/display/.
criteria_check.evidence: Moved 482 lines (plan_suffix through introspection) to crates/athena-cli/src/display/status_view.rs and added about 9 lines of mod and use. The 1504 base lines therefore become about 1030. The unchanged part of the file is 2609 lines, and the test module starts after roughly 1460. I did not run code health itself.

criteria_check.criterion: Public functions of display (status, snapshot_status, etc.) keep their paths and signatures via `pub use`/`use` re-exports; no caller outside display changes; function bodies are moved verbatim.
criteria_check.evidence: display.rs has `pub use status_view::{snapshot_status, status}`. It also has `use status_view::introspection`, and a cfg(test)-only import of the helpers the tests call. Bodies were copied unchanged. The only edits are `pub(super)` on helpers, and the `mistakes`, `usd` and similar helpers are imported from the parent. Only display.rs, the new file and CHANGELOG.md changed. Clippy on all athena-cli targets compiles every caller.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`: all existing display tests pass unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --lib display`: 22 passed, 0 failed. The tests module is untouched. I did not run the whole athena-cli suite.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets`: both clean.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all and `cargo clippy -p athena-cli --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, which was clean.

criteria_check.criterion: No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, Cargo configs) are changed; no test is deleted or weakened.
criteria_check.evidence: The changed files are display.rs, display/status_view.rs and CHANGELOG.md. The tests module is untouched. The policy test passed.

open_issues: I did not run the code-health measurement, so the exact production-line count of display.rs is my estimate of about 1030.
learnings: display.rs is a plain module file, so a sibling display/ directory holds a submodule with no rename. Child modules reach the parent's private helpers through super::. The tests use `use super::*`, so the moved helpers they call need a cfg(test) import in the parent to avoid unused-import warnings.
I had no tool for deleting a line range, so I removed the block with a single Edit that matched the whole block.
